body.x: Restrict leave in peak periods so there is enough manpower during high-volume windows.
Keep coverage through peak operational periods, especially between month-end and month-start, when deposit and withdrawal volumes are high and PG or banking instability is more likely.

head: Provision
Detail
rows: Judged on manpower availability. Generally discouraged, to avoid staffing gaps
No fixed dates. AL in peak periods (around month-end and month-start) needs approval from the ATL or above
Emergency or critical leave only, with approval from the ATL or above and supporting reasons submitted as early as possible
Everyone must follow this policy. Non-compliance may disrupt operations and lead to disciplinary action
